name: Portal
instructions: Own and install Portal (Steam App 400) from Steam on a PC.
Choose the Portal installation folder containing portal/, hl2/, and platform/ in Render360. On iPhone/iPad, copy that installed folder into Files/iCloud/USB storage first.
Choose a Render360 Portal Source WebAssembly runtime package built from the pinned community source. Render360 never needs a Windows portal.exe to execute in the browser.
Launch. Player-owned game files stay local and are mounted read-only; they are not bundled into the WebAssembly engine.
